paper.title: RobotPan: A 360° Surround-View Robotic Vision System for Embodied Perception

review.question: 近一年鱼眼镜头（含全景/环视/超广角相机）在具身智能领域的应用方式、效果与局限是什么？哪些任务获益、哪些受限？

relevance.reason: 对综述问题高度相关的环视系统证据：(1) 应用方式——在人形平台 Tiangong 3.0 上以六台 118°×92° 超广角相机+40 线 LiDAR 的环视 rig 替代多鱼眼拼接实现 360° 视觉，并明确给出'相机无法共置→经典鱼眼拼接不可用→需几何感知视图合成'的方案分界；(2) 效果——自建环视数据集上 4 视角 NVS 24.70 dB/327K 高斯（对比 DepthSplat 22.97/1261K）、流式 28.59 dB/0.47 s/帧/230 FPS、球面体素消融 1261K→327K，并给出 339 片段多传感器数据集；(3) 局限——无位姿设定落后 Pi3、公共基准互有胜负、存储非最优（4DGS 0.3 vs 7.2 MB）、人因收益（模拟器眩晕/态势感知）未实验验证、数据采集用保守化人穿戴协议——'获益（环视渲染/重建/流式）与受限（无位姿几何、人因验证、步态抖动）'两端证据齐全。

sections_read.purpose: 确认问题定义：人机回路中前视窄视场限制态势感知、多相机切换打断工作流、HMD 抖动引发模拟器眩晕；提出六相机+LiDAR 环视系统；提取'多鱼眼 rig 光心可近似共置而本系统相机不可共置'的方案分界陈述。
定位相关工作版图：前馈重建（DUSt3R/MASt3R/VGGT/Pi3）、可泛化 NVS、3DGS 量化、足式/人形全景感知（HumanoidPano/四足多模态占据/OneOcc/碰撞避让）；确认本文定位为通用可部署 360° 环视视觉系统。
精读方法：VGGT 式交替注意力+π3 置换等变几何预测、LiDAR 监督度量微调、机器人中心球面体素化（近细远粗）、每体素固定数高斯解码、流式融合（共享高斯+动态高斯+tiny-MLP 残差精修+距离图像域多视一致性动态掩膜）。
精读全部定量结果：点图估计（自建有/无位姿+DTU/ETH3D）、4 视角 NVS（Table 3）与跨数据集泛化（Table 4）、流式 NVS（Table 5）、范式消融（Table 6）、流式融合消融（Table 7）。
提取结论与检查限制陈述：结论重述系统/方法/数据集贡献；无独立 Limitations 小节，仅在与基线比较处承认 4DGS 存储更紧凑、IGS 内存略小、RealEstate10K PSNR 非最佳。

sections_skipped.reason: 参考文献列表，无补充实验；scoping 模式下仅按需核对被引方法名（DUSt3R/VGGT/Pi3 等）。

research_question: 本论文问题：如何在人形机器人上以多相机环视 rig（相机光心不可共置）实现实时、度量一致、可流式的 360° 视觉接口，支撑遥操作/导航/移动操作等人机回路与自主任务。综述问题映射：该工作代表'环视（超广角多相机而非鱼眼拼接）'这一路线在具身领域的应用方式、量化效果与边界，并与多鱼眼全景 rig 形成直接对照。
contributions: ROBOTPAN 前馈管线：从标定稀疏视角经层级球面体素先验预测度量尺度、紧凑 3D 高斯，支持实时 360° 环视渲染与度量重建。
流式高斯更新策略：增量融合多帧多相机预测，更新动态内容、防止静态区域无界增长（共享高斯+tiny-MLP 残差精修）。
部署于 Tiangong 3.0 人形平台的六相机+LiDAR 球面环视视觉系统（硬件 rig + 可穿戴采集装置）。
首个面向机器人 360° 新视图合成与度量 3D 重建的多传感器数据集与基准（339 片段，含 ~80% 动态场景）。（'首个'为作者自述）

method.summary: 系统层：六台 118°×92° RGB 相机均匀分布在半径 89 mm 圆环（0/±60/±120/180°）+头顶 40 线 LiDAR，联合标定与时间同步；作者强调因硬件约束相机光心不可共置，经典多鱼眼拼接不可用，故走'几何感知视图合成'路线。算法层：VGGT 式交替注意力 transformer（DINOv2 backbone，π3 置换等变改造，36 块）做前馈多视几何预测；预测点图变换到机器人中心球面坐标并体素化为近细远粗的层级球面格；每体素解码固定数量高斯（锚点+MLP 头）；LiDAR 投影监督+尺度感知点损失对齐度量尺度；流式阶段以共享高斯集+帧级动态高斯+tiny-MLP 残差精修维持紧凑表征，用距离图像域多视融合识别动态区域。
assumptions: 六相机外参与内参已标定且时间同步（位姿已知条件下几何优势显著，无位姿设定不保证领先）。
LiDAR 可用并已与相机联合标定，用于度量监督（纯视觉部署需另行解决尺度）。
场景可由机器人中心球面体素层级良好表达（近场细/远场粗假设）。
动态区域可通过 2D 分割+多视球面距离图像融合可靠识别。

datasets: RobotPan 自建数据集：339 同步片段×200 帧，6 相机+LiDAR，室内外多场景，~80% 动态，1920×1536（训练 518×406），80/10/10 划分
DTU、ETH3D（点图重建公共基准，每 5 帧采样关键帧）
DL3DV-Benchmarks、RealEstate10K（可泛化 NVS 公共基准）
流式评测：10 个动态子场景（200 帧×6 视角）
tasks: 稀疏视角点图/度量 3D 重建（有/无位姿）
流式动态场景新视图合成（在线/离线对比）
面向遥操作/导航/移动操作的环视渲染接口（声称的下游用途，未直接评测）
embodiments: Tiangong 3.0 人形机器人（部署平台）
人穿戴同构头戴采集 rig（数据采集）
study_context.sample_or_scale: 339 片段×200 帧×6 视角；流式评测 10 子场景×1,200 图像；8 GPU 训练（π3 checkpoint 初始化+LiDAR 微调+渲染联合训练）

evaluation.design: 在自建环视基准与 4 个公共基准上与代表性前馈重建/NVS 方法对比（有/无位姿两设定）；流式任务与在线（逐帧更新）和离线（全序列优化）两类基线对比；辅以预测范式与流式组件消融。
baselines: 流式：离线 K-Planes、4DGS、Spacetime-GS；在线 StreamRF、3DGStream、IGS
metrics: 每帧训练时间（s）与渲染 FPS
ablations: 高斯预测范式：像素式 vs 笛卡尔体素式 vs 球面体素式（Table 6）
流式组件：朴素拼接 / 去距离图像融合 / 去 tiny-MLP / 完整模型（Table 7）
层级球面设计存储削减 ~70%（Sec 2.3 陈述）

findings.finding: 六相机环视 rig 因光心不可共置而无法沿用多鱼眼拼接，需前馈几何感知视图合成实现 360° 视觉接口。
findings.scope: Tiangong 3.0 人形平台头部环视系统设计（作者论述）

findings.finding: 自建环视数据集 4 视角 NVS：24.70 dB/0.811/0.197，327K 高斯，比每像素法少 3.86×、比 pixelSplat 少 11.57×，同时全面优于 pixelSplat/MVSplat/FLARE/DepthSplat。
流式 NVS：28.59 dB、0.47 s/帧更新、230 FPS、7.2 MB，优于全部在线基线（IGS 27.75/3.65/204/6.5 等）与离线基线质量。
findings.scope: 10 个动态子场景（200 帧×6 视角）流式设定（Table 5）

findings.finding: 球面体素范式相对像素式把 1,261K/378 MB 压缩到 327K/97 MB 且 PSNR +3.27 dB；球面优于笛卡尔体素（机器人中心几何适配）。
条件性结果：有位姿时自建数据集点图 Overall 0.268 优于 Pi3 0.332；无位姿时 Acc./Overall（0.612/0.482）劣于 Pi3（0.580/0.460）；公共基准 DTU Overall 略优、ETH3D Overall 劣于 Pi3。
朴素逐帧拼接在 200 帧内膨胀到 65,400K 高斯/19,400 MB，证实长序列必须共享紧凑表征；距离图像融合与 tiny-MLP 精修各贡献可测质量增益。

author_stated.limitation: 存储紧凑性非最优：离线 4DGS 存储 0.3 MB 远小于本方法 7.2 MB（需全序列优化故不适配低延迟流式）；在线 IGS 内存占用也略小于本方法（6.5 vs 7.2 MB），作者以渲染质量与速度作为补偿论据。
author_stated.locator: page 10, Section 3.4 Comparison 末段（4DGS 数字见 page 9, Table 5）

author_stated.limitation: 公共基准非全面领先：RealEstate10K 上 PSNR 27.43 低于 DepthSplat 27.47（作者自述'其余指标保持有竞争力'）；DTU/ETH3D 上 Acc./Comp./Overall 与 Pi3 互有胜负。

reader_inferred.boundary: 人因收益未验证：模拟器眩晕、态势感知、遥操作工作流收益止于动机陈述，全文无人因/操作者实验（全部指标为 Chamfer/PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS/存储/时间类代理指标）。
reader_inferred.basis: page 1 摘要-引言动机 vs page 7-10 实验范围与 page 11 结论的对照（见 C12）。

reader_inferred.boundary: 无位姿鲁棒性证据不足：自建数据集无位姿设定下 Acc./Overall 落后 Pi3，'强鲁棒性'宣称应限定为有标定/位姿条件。
reader_inferred.basis: page 7, Table 1 数字（0.612/0.482 vs Pi3 0.580/0.460）与正文宣称的对照（见 C06）。

reader_inferred.boundary: 运动分布保守：数据由人穿戴同构 rig+颈部稳定器采集，步速 ≤1.2 m/s、转向 ≤0.4 rad/s，未覆盖真实人形步态抖动/更高动态运动；系统对 gait-induced jitter 的实际鲁棒性未被该数据协议直接检验。
reader_inferred.basis: page 7, Section 3.1 Data collection 协议（见 C15）；抖动作为动机在 page 1 提出。

reader_inferred.boundary: 度量尺度依赖 LiDAR：系统标定与度量监督均依赖 40 线 LiDAR 联合标定，纯视觉（鱼眼/全景相机-only）部署的尺度一致性未被评估。
reader_inferred.basis: page 3-5, Sections 2.2/2.5 LiDAR 监督设计；实验均基于 6 相机+LiDAR rig。

reader_inferred.boundary: 下游机器人任务未闭环评测：声称服务 SLAM/闭环控制/导航/操作，但未报告任何下游任务指标（SLAM 精度、操作成功率、碰撞率等）。
reader_inferred.basis: page 1 动机与 page 7-10 实验范围的对照。

reader_inferred.boundary: 基线设定公平性存疑：NVS 基线（pixelSplat/MVSplat/DepthSplat 等）为前向/物体重建设定设计，被放入低重叠环视稀疏视角设定，对该设定下的基线不利；且未与任何多鱼眼拼接/传统全景管线做对比（论文以'不适用'论证替代实证对比）。
reader_inferred.basis: page 2-3 Related Works 与 page 7-8 实验设定；无拼接基线出现在 Tables 1-7。

transfer_boundary: 结论可迁移范围：已标定、时间同步的六相机（118°×92°）+LiDAR 环视 rig，在 200 帧量级片段、人穿戴保守运动（≤1.2 m/s/≤0.4 rad/s）采集、室内外场景上，前馈球面体素高斯可获得 24.70-28.59 dB 渲染质量、327K-3,023K 高斯、0.47 s/帧流式更新与 230 FPS 渲染；有位姿时度量重建优于 Pi3。不可迁移/未验证：无位姿优势、无 LiDAR 的纯视觉度量尺度、真实人形步态抖动下的鲁棒性、以及遥操作/导航/操作等人因或任务级收益；存储紧凑性相对 4DGS（0.3 MB）与 IGS（6.5 MB）非最优。

design_strengths: 前馈设计避免逐场景优化，流式更新 0.47 s/帧与 230 FPS 渲染直接对应具身低延迟需求，且有在线/离线两类基线对照。
球面体素近细远粗设计与机器人中心场景几何匹配，Table 6 消融（像素/笛卡尔/球面三范式）对'为何球面'给出同设定归因证据。
LiDAR 度量监督+四项损失（渲染×2+点+法线）使重建具备度量一致性，服务于 SLAM/闭环控制诉求。
Table 7 消融（朴素拼接 65,400K/19,400 MB）量化了长序列共享表征的必要性，设计归因清晰。
双公共基准（DTU/ETH3D、DL3DV/RealEstate10K）提供超出自建数据的外部检查点。
design_risks: 主战场为自建基准与自定协议（4-view、200 帧、末 20 帧抽测），存在有利于自身设计的设定选择风险。
NVS 基线多为前向/物体重建方法，置于低重叠环视设定未必是其设计最优条件；未与多鱼眼拼接/传统全景管线实证对比。
人因动机（模拟器眩晕、态势感知、工作流）无操作者实验验证，动机与证据脱节。
数据采集用保守化人穿戴协议（限速+颈部稳定器），与人形平台真实步态抖动的差距未量化。
未报告前馈网络本身的端到端推理延迟（230 FPS 为渲染速度，0.47 s 为流式每帧更新时间），'实时系统'整体延迟链路不完整。
无方差/显著性报告，部分优势幅度小（RealEstate10K SSIM 0.896 vs 0.889），单次运行结果的可复现波动未知。
critical_appraisal.baseline_fairness: 重建基线（DUSt3R/Pi3/VGGT 等）为通用方法且按其原协议评测，相对公平；NVS 基线被置于其非设计设定的环视低重叠场景，对基线不利；无位姿设定下落后 Pi3 说明基线仍具竞争力；缺少与经典多鱼眼全景拼接或全景相机原生方案的对照。
critical_appraisal.metric_validity: Chamfer/PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS/高斯数/存储/时间为渲染与重建代理指标，不直接测量遥操作绩效、态势感知或模拟器眩晕等论文动机声称的具身收益；紧凑性与速度指标对部署相关，但缺少端到端系统延迟与机器人下游任务指标。
critical_appraisal.reproducibility: 中上：公布项目网站与数据集/基准（作者表述）、训练细节（π3 初始化、8 GPU、AdamW 超参、双阶段训练）完整；但 12 页正文未见代码发布承诺与随机种子/方差信息，流式评测协议细节（子场景选择标准）部分依赖作者自定。
critical_appraisal.external_validity: 有限-中等：跨 DTU/ETH3D/DL3DV/RealEstate10K 的泛化测试存在且互有胜负（多数指标最佳、个别略逊）；但所有'具身'结论限定于单一人形平台头部几何、单一 rig 配置与保守运动分布，向其他平台/传感器配置/动态等级的外推未检验。

evidence_cards.claim: RobotPan 的应用方式：在人形平台 Tiangong 3.0 上用六台相机的环视 rig（而非多鱼眼全景 rig）实现 360° 视觉；作者明确说明因硬件约束六相机光学中心无法共置，经典多鱼眼拼接管线不适用，必须用几何感知的视图合成来获得环视画面。
evidence_cards.relation: 支持命题：具身智能中环视/360° 视觉的一种核心实现路径，并揭示多相机环视与多鱼眼拼接 rig 的关键差别（光学中心能否近似共置决定能否用经典拼接）——界定鱼眼/全景方案与多相机方案的适用边界。
evidence_cards.summary: 引言指出多鱼眼全景 rig 近似单一光心故可拼接，而本系统相机受硬件约束无法共置，经典图像拼接管线不可用，需要有原理的几何感知视图合成。

verification.rationale: page 1 引言原文逐字给出 multi-fisheye panoramic rigs approximate a single optical center、our cameras cannot be co-located due to hardware constraints、classical image-stitching pipelines inapplicable、requires principled geometry-aware view synthesis 四个要点；claim 为作者论述的忠实复述，未附加论文外断言。

evidence_cards.claim: 具身人机回路（遥操作、数据采集、紧急接管）中窄视场前视相机的问题陈述：受限视场降低态势感知，操作者需以不舒服的身体/头部旋转去“搜索”视点；机器人传感布局与人眼差异导致 HMD 视图不稳定并引发模拟器眩晕。
evidence_cards.relation: 支持命题：说明具身智能为何需要 360°/环视视觉接口（任务动机端），是全景/超广角相机在具身领域获益任务（遥操作、数据采集、紧急接管）的直接作者论述。
evidence_cards.summary: 引言逐条列出前视相机受限视场的三个实际问题：态势感知受限、需要不舒服的体位搜索视点、多相机切换打断工作流；摘要同时指出运动诱发抖动导致 HMD 模拟器眩晕。

verification.rationale: page 1 原文逐字给出 restricted situational awareness、uncomfortable body/head rotations to search for viewpoints 等表述（摘要段另证 simulator sickness，见 C12 context）；claim 限定于作者陈述的动机，未声称已被实验验证。

evidence_cards.claim: 环视 rig 硬件配置：六台向外 RGB 相机均匀分布在半径 89 mm 的圆环上，方位角 0°/±60°/±120°/180°，每台相机水平视场 118°、垂直视场 92°；配合头顶 40 线激光雷达（水平 360°、垂直 59°）提供多模态数据。
evidence_cards.relation: 支持命题：给出环视具身系统的具体传感器选型参数（超广角 118°×92° 相机 ×6 + LiDAR），是“全景/环视/超广角相机在具身智能中的应用方式”的硬件层证据。
evidence_cards.summary: 3.1 节传感器布局段给出圆环半径、六个方位角、每相机 118°×92° 视场与 40 线 LiDAR 覆盖，并称该几何保证稳健的多视重叠。

Our dataset contains 339 synchronized
clips, each with 200 frames, captured with a calibrated
rig consisting of six RGB cameras and one LiDAR. The
sequences cover diverse indoor environments (office build-
ings, households, exhibition halls, and factories) and outdoor
environments (urban blocks, industrial parks, and roads).
All sensors are time-synchronized and jointly calibrated,
enabling consistent multi-view and multi-sensor geometry.
The RGB cameras record at a resolution of 1920×1536, and
we downsample images to 518×406 during training. The
dataset features substantial non-rigid and dynamic content,
with dynamic scenes accounting for approximately 80% of
the clips, including crowded pedestrian scenarios.

3.3 Generalized Novel View Synthesis
Datasets. We evaluate generalized novel view synthe-
sis on both our proposed surround-view robotic dataset
and two public benchmarks, DL3DV-Benchmarks [58] and
RealEstate10K [59]. Our proposed dataset is designed
for sparse-view robotic perception with large viewpoint
changes and limited overlap across input cameras, making
view synthesis substantially more challenging than stan-
dard forward-facing or object-centric settings. To further
assess generalization, we also report results on DL3DV-
Benchmarks and RealEstate10K, which are widely used
benchmarks for feed-forward novel view synthesis.
Metrics and baselines. We compare our method
against representative feed-forward novel view synthe-
sis approaches, including pixelSplat [26], MVSplat [27],
FLARE [12], and DepthSplat [34]. Following standard prac-
tice, we report PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, where higher
PSNR/SSIM and lower LPIPS indicate better rendering
quality. In addition to image quality, we also compare the
number of rendered Gaussians to evaluate representation
compactness and rendering efficiency.
Comparison. Tab. 3 reports quantitative results on our pro-
posed dataset under the 4-view setting. Despite the highly
sparse-view configuration, our method achieves the best
performance across all three image quality metrics while us-
ing a substantially more compact Gaussian representation.
Our method achieves the best rendering quality while using
a substantially more compact representation. Specifically,
it uses only 327K Gaussians, which is 3.86× fewer than
recent one-Gaussian-per-pixel methods and 11.57× fewer
than pixelSplat (multiple-Gaussian-per-pixel).

Ours (Streaming) 28.59 0.47 230 7.2
Metrics and baselines. Following prior work [64], we report
PSNR, Storage usage, Training time, and Rendering speed
for comparison with previous approaches. For online training
methods, the first-frame observations are used to initialize
the scene representation, and the subsequent frames are in-
corporated incrementally through per-frame updates. In this
setting, we compare against StreamRF [63], 3DGStream [54],
and IGS [64]. For offline training methods, all frames in each
sequence are jointly used for training. The offline baselines
include K-Planes [60], 4DGS [61], and Spacetime-GS [62].
All reported metrics are averaged over the full 200-frame
sequence, including frame 0.
Comparison with offline and online methods. We compare
our streaming framework against both offline and online
training methods on the proposed multi-view camera dy-
namic scene dataset, with quantitative results reported in
Tab. 5. Compared to offline methods, our approach achieves
the best rendering quality, reaching 28.59 dB PSNR and
outperforming K-Planes, 4DGS, and Spacetime-GS by a
clear margin. At the same time, our method preserves real-
time rendering efficiency at 230 FPS, matching the fastest
online baseline and substantially exceeding most offline
alternatives.

tion scheme, the scene representation allocates Gaussians
more efficiently across space, allowing us to model the
scene with a smaller number of Gaussians while preserving
reconstruction fidelity. This compact representation further
reduces computational rendering overhead and contributes
to the high rendering speed achieved by our proposed
method. Although offline methods such as 4DGS are more
compact in storage, they require sequence-level optimiza-
tion over the entire scene and therefore are not suitable for
practical low-latency streaming applications in robotics.
Compared to prior online training methods, our method
achieves the best overall trade-off between rendering qual-
ity, training efficiency, rendering speed, and storage usage.
Specifically, our streaming variant outperforms StreamRF,
3DGStream, and IGS in PSNR, while reducing the per-
frame training time to only 0.47 seconds. This is more than
26× faster than 3DGStream, more than 33× faster than
StreamRF, and about 7.8× faster than IGS. In addition,
our method achieves the highest rendering speed among
all online baselines at 230 FPS. While IGS is slightly more
compact in memory footprint, our method provides better
rendering quality and substantially faster rendering, leading
to the strongest overall performance in streaming settings.
These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our
streaming design. By performing scene initialization and
sequential updates in a feed-forward manner, our method
avoids the heavy optimization cost of prior online ap-
proaches and thus greatly reduces update latency. Further-
more, our spherical voxelization scheme enables a com-
pact Gaussian representation that allocates model capacity
more efficiently in space, thereby lowering rendering cost
while preserving reconstruction quality. Consequently, our
method effectively overcomes the typical trade-off between
quality and efficiency in online novel view synthesis.
3.5 Ablation Study
Spherical voxel-wise prediction. Tab. 6 compares three
Gaussian prediction paradigms: pixel-wise, Cartesian voxel-
wise, and spherical voxel-wise. Both voxel-wise variants
outperform pixel-wise prediction by aggregating nearby
observations into compact anchor features, which reduces
redundancy and improves rendering quality. In particular,
spherical voxel-wise prediction achieves the best overall re-
sults, reducing the representation from 1261K to 327K Gaus-
sians and from 378 MB to 97 MB, while improving PSNR/S-
SIM/LPIPS from 21.43/0.713/0.341 to 24.70/0.811/0.197.

3.5 Ablation Study
Spherical voxel-wise prediction. Tab. 6 compares three
Gaussian prediction paradigms: pixel-wise, Cartesian voxel-
wise, and spherical voxel-wise. Both voxel-wise variants
outperform pixel-wise prediction by aggregating nearby
observations into compact anchor features, which reduces
redundancy and improves rendering quality. In particular,
spherical voxel-wise prediction achieves the best overall re-

These results show that structured local aggregation is more
suitable for our multi-view robotic setting than directly
regressing dense pixel-aligned primitives.
Compared with Cartesian voxels, spherical voxels are
better aligned with our robot-centric surround-view setting.
Their volume increases with radius, naturally assigning
finer resolution to near-field regions and coarser resolu-
tion to distant areas. This radius-adaptive hierarchy better
matches the geometry distribution of embodied scenes,
yielding both higher compactness and better rendering
quality than uniform Cartesian voxelization.
Streaming fusion. Tab. 7 validates the effectiveness of the
proposed streaming fusion design for streaming novel view
synthesis. Naive concatenation causes severe redundancy
across time, increasing the representation to 65,400K Gaus-
sians and 19,400 MB storage, which is impractical for long
sequences despite reasonable rendering quality.

evidence_cards.claim: 动机-证据缺口：论文以“运动诱发抖动导致 HMD 模拟器眩晕”与窄视场/多相机切换打断操作者工作流作为系统动机，但全文实验只覆盖点图重建、稀疏/流式新视图合成等代理指标，未报告任何操作者实验（如模拟器眩晕量表、态势感知或遥操作绩效）来直接验证这些动机收益。
evidence_cards.relation: 缺口命题：环视视觉对人机回路任务（遥操作/数据采集/紧急接管）的收益在本文止于动机陈述，缺少人因层面的证据——综述回答“哪些任务获益”时，此类收益应标注为未验证主张。
evidence_cards.summary: 摘要与引言提出 HMD 模拟器眩晕、工作流打断等动机；但 Section 3 实验全部为重建/NVS 指标（Table 1-7），Section 4 结论也未报告操作者研究。

3.3 Generalized Novel View Synthesis
Datasets. We evaluate generalized novel view synthe-
sis on both our proposed surround-view robotic dataset
and two public benchmarks, DL3DV-Benchmarks [58] and
RealEstate10K [59]. Our proposed dataset is designed
for sparse-view robotic perception with large viewpoint
changes and limited overlap across input cameras, making
view synthesis substantially more challenging than stan-
dard forward-facing or object-centric settings. To further
assess generalization, we also report results on DL3DV-
Benchmarks and RealEstate10K, which are widely used
benchmarks for feed-forward novel view synthesis.
Metrics and baselines. We compare our method
against representative feed-forward novel view synthe-
sis approaches, including pixelSplat [26], MVSplat [27],
FLARE [12], and DepthSplat [34]. Following standard prac-
tice, we report PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, where higher
PSNR/SSIM and lower LPIPS indicate better rendering
quality. In addition to image quality, we also compare the
number of rendered Gaussians to evaluate representation
compactness and rendering efficiency.
Comparison. Tab. 3 reports quantitative results on our pro-
posed dataset under the 4-view setting. Despite the highly
sparse-view configuration, our method achieves the best
performance across all three image quality metrics while us-
ing a substantially more compact Gaussian representation.
Our method achieves the best rendering quality while using
a substantially more compact representation. Specifically,
it uses only 327K Gaussians, which is 3.86× fewer than
recent one-Gaussian-per-pixel methods and 11.57× fewer
than pixelSplat (multiple-Gaussian-per-pixel). This result
highlights the advantage of our anchor-wise representation
in producing higher-quality renderings with significantly
reduced redundancy.

evidence_cards.claim: 度量一致性的实现方式：为满足 SLAM 与闭环控制等下游任务对度量一致场景的要求，作者用 LiDAR 监督微调几何预测器，把预测点图对齐到每个相机坐标系下的 LiDAR 度量几何；训练损失含 LiDAR 稀疏尺度感知点损失与 π3 伪法线损失。
evidence_cards.relation: 支持命题：环视多相机系统获得“度量尺度”的关键手段是相机-LiDAR 联合标定与监督——说明具身环视视觉要服务闭环控制时普遍需要额外度量锚定（鱼眼/全景纯视觉方案需另行解决尺度问题）。
evidence_cards.summary: 2.2 节末与 2.5 节说明 LiDAR 监督微调与四项训练目标（MSE/LPIPS 渲染损失+LiDAR 点损失+法线损失）。

evidence_cards.claim: 数据采集协议：训练/评估数据由人佩戴与机器人同构的头戴式采集系统采集（操作者平均身高约 160 cm 以匹配人形平台传感器高度），并加颈部稳定器抑制头部诱发运动、执行保守运动剖面——步速限制 ≤1.2 m/s、转向速度 ≤0.4 rad/s 以保证数据一致性。
evidence_cards.relation: 支持命题（应用方式+边界）：环视数据集以人体穿戴同构 rig 而非机器人本体采集，其运动分布是刻意保守化的（限速+稳定器）——这同时是理解该系统对真实人形步态抖动鲁棒性证据强度的边界条件。
